title: Optional alert on REST API Upload error
body:
Enhancement request.
Optional alert after x number of consecutive REST API Upload errors.
This alert would inform the user to potential network problems when trying to upload data to NS or their OpenAPS rig.
I my setup it would indicate a problem with my full time BT tether to my OpenAPS rig.

comments.body:
+1
Sometimes my Azure NS site stops taking data and needs to be restarted.  I can't tell this is happening unless I go into system status and see that the rest api uploads are backing up.  Would be great to get notifications that this is going on so I can restart my ns site.
Also, the API error remains on the status screen for hours, even after uploading has subsequently succeeded.  I haven't figured out how or why the error disappears yet.

The 16th Aug nightly now has this feature. It appears to work well in my local testing, please let me know. There is an extra option to turn the alerts on/off from the Rest API cloud upload settings page.
Has anyone seen this alert be raised yet? @zjedr  ?

I haven't done a controlled test and I thought it wasn't working but I got the alert for the 1st time today after an extended period of my openAPS rig being offline. When I got the alert it said it had missed 6 uploads, I would like to get the alert after 2 consecutive missed uploads.
@zjedr Is this working?  Have you been able to test it?

> Also, the API error remains on the status screen for hours, even after uploading has subsequently succeeded. I haven't figured out how or why the error disappears yet.

Is there any information about when and why the message finally disappears?
